description: (needs account token) Chooses which of a site's domains is its main name: the one that serves the site and that search engines and shared links use. The site's other domains redirect (301) to it. confirm=true applies it. Does not charge.

confirm.description: True applies the change. False leaves it unchanged and the reply describes what would change.

domain.description: One of the domains already on the site.

site.description: The address of a site on this account, for example myproject.dropthehassle.app.

name: make_primary_domain
title: Make primary domain
